theorem labelled_hinge_convex_differentiable_iff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (y : ℝ) (z : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z x) 0) ∧

qualification.explicit_proposal: At each point, the hinge is differentiable iff its affine margin is not exactly zero. It is globally differentiable iff y•z=0; otherwise a genuine boundary kink exists. This is an explicit qualification, not author-endorsed erratum.
qualification.simple_counterexample: y=0 or z=0 gives constant max(1,0)=1, differentiable everywhere.
